Class Fleet

java.lang.Object
Fleet
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Fleet extends Object implements Serializable
The fleet of the Coconut Grove Sailing Club: an arbitrary number of boats, kept in the order in which they joined the fleet. The fleet finds its boats by name and reports what they cost to buy and to maintain.
Author:
Maxime Manuel Afonso
